Name: 8 Ball Champion
Overview:
8 Ball Pool Champion is a recreation of the American 8 ball pool game, in which two players or two teams of players attempts to pot his/hers.their set of balls into 6 pockets around the edge of the pool table the first. However, Instead of focusing on realistic physics simulation, 8 Ball Pool Champion instead features a more arcade style of play. By utilizing the 'Cheat-O-Laser, the player can pull off shoots that rebounds of several bumpers in a bouncy, kinetic way.

Players can play against an A.I opponent, or play with up to three other friends in a local offline game.
